recommended.production_forecast_generator: No method is certified. Same-mesh adaptive Q2 is the strongest startup challenger, but it failed the density timestep and half-step mass gates. The next diagnostic isolates unlimited Q2 time sensitivity from accumulated postprocessing. Q1 remains the controlled baseline.
recommended.independent_validator: Develop a dynamically scaled and translated whole-space Hermite-Galerkin reference after the Q2 gate, validated by mode-tail and moment convergence; retain exact-native-law Monte Carlo for moment uncertainty and the independent FV hierarchy for current triangulation.
recommended.neural_operator_target_representation: If a pilot is run: float64 exact conservative subcell averages; Q1 requires 2 subcells per native cell per axis (60x72x72 for the tested 30x36x36 mesh).

expected_full_density_error.warning: The finite-volume level is not converged and KDE bandwidth materially changes the result.

expected_cost_per_DA_forecast.scope: One 0.05 forecast interval; MC figure excludes principled bandwidth selection and accuracy certification.

recommended.principal_remaining_limitation: Adaptive Q2 has strong startup covariance and marginal accuracy but fails the predeclared density timestep gate; no corrected mature-posterior forecast or converged deterministic full-density reference exists.

pde.type_full_rank_B: transient spatially variable-coefficient uniformly parabolic convection-diffusion Fokker-Planck equation
pde.type_rank_deficient_B: degenerate parabolic; potentially hypoelliptic only if the appropriate bracket condition holds
pde.implication: Lorenz phase-volume contraction amplifies density along drift characteristics; omitting the divergence/compression term changes the PDE.

bayesian_analysis.nodal_operation: Nodal interpolation of L(x)p_h(x), followed by normalization and limiting; it is not an L2 projection.
bayesian_analysis.implemented_operation: Find q_h with (q_h,v_h)=(L p_h,v_h) using quadrature degree 14, normalize by its finite-element evidence, then apply the conservative positivity limiter.
bayesian_analysis.conclusion: Projection is materially better at fine Q1 resolution, but its 5.69% positivity correction is itself too large for certification.

weak_form_and_boundary.audit: The UFL volume, upwind interior flux, SIPG consistency/symmetry/penalty terms, and theta update match the broken conservative total-flux derivation.
weak_form_and_boundary.exterior_flux_statement: The derivation removes the single exterior term integral_boundary (f p-D grad p).n v. Omitting exterior contributions in the split code therefore sets the numerical total flux to zero; it must not be interpreted as requiring both physical component fluxes to vanish separately.
weak_form_and_boundary.manufactured_solution: p=C exp(0.4x-0.3y+0.2z), D=I/2, f=(0.2,-0.15,0.1), so J=0 while component normal fluxes are nonzero.

higher_order.q2_projection_theorem: On affine hexahedra, exact L2 projection into discontinuous Q2 preserves integrals against 1, x_i, x_i x_j, and x_i^2 because these test functions lie in Q2. Hence mass and first/second raw moments are preserved before limiting, assuming exact-enough quadrature.
higher_order.comparison_confound: Q2 used cells 1.5 times wider in every direction and dt=0.00125 versus Q1 dt=0.000625, so equal global DOFs do not isolate polynomial degree.
higher_order.conclusion: Current corrected Q2 is not adopted. The existing result rejects that configuration but cannot reject Q2 polynomial degree; a same-physical-mesh, same-timestep comparison is required.

independent_reference.method: First-order cell-centred upwind finite volume, centred diagonal diffusion, SSPRK(3,3), zero total numerical boundary flux
independent_reference.scope: Independent validator for default diagonal D only; not a high-order production candidate
independent_reference.conclusion: The hierarchy trends toward MC and Q1 but is not converged enough to assign either method a full-density truth error.

monte_carlo_as_production.conclusion: MC moments are accurate and cheap, but 200000 particles do not define a stable full 3-D target without a bandwidth-dependent reconstruction. MC is not selected as the production target generator.

adaptivity.runtime_probe: dolfinx.mesh.refine on a hexahedral box fails for both uniform and marked-edge calls with RuntimeError: Refinement only defined for simplices
alternatives: tetrahedral h-adaptivity with a new positivity proof
structured local refinement outside the current Domain/export assumptions
adaptivity.reason: Changing topology would invalidate the present tensor-product Bernstein control and conservative tensor interface unless redesigned.

characteristic_challenger.reason: The closest mass-preserving Lagrange-Galerkin theory assumes a characteristic map that remains in the domain (including a zero-boundary velocity hypothesis in its estimates) and does not provide positivity; Lorenz drift is nonzero on the truncation boundary. The SLDG-LDG evidence is limited to 1-D/2-D tests and does not establish the required reflecting boundary or positivity in 3-D. The requested condition that assumptions be sufficiently close was therefore not met.
characteristic_challenger.smallest_prerequisite: Derive and verify a boundary-consistent characteristic remap with total reflection and a whole-cell positivity construction before a numerical comparison.

mature_DA.interpretation: An operational distribution appears at this coarse configuration, but the numerical posterior family is not accurate enough to validate as production input. No corrected mature forecast at 30x36x36 or finer exists.

error_budget.temporal_reference: At 12x16x16, BE dt=0.000625 versus 0.0003125 changes covariance Frobenius norm by 0.0170; a fine-mesh normalized value remains unmeasured.
error_budget.boundary: Manufactured total-flux test converges at order 2 with mass error below 3.2e-12; finite-box truncation on mature states remains unmeasured.
error_budget.export: Q1 two-subcell and Q2 three-subcell round trips pass at approximately 1e-10 or better; mass is at roundoff.
error_budget.additivity_warning: These controlled estimates are coupled and are not algebraically summed.

decision_thresholds.covariance: E_cov <= 0.03 and R_cov <= 5 on both startup and corrected mature states
decision_thresholds.full_density: Set only after the independent deterministic hierarchy is converged; current reference disagreement is too large
decision_thresholds.limiter: forecast mean relative L1 <= 0.001, maximum <= 0.005; analysis relative L1 <= 0.005
decision_thresholds.temporal: halving dt changes E_cov by <= 0.003 and L1 by <= 0.0025
decision_thresholds.boundary: expanded-domain mature E_cov and marginal TV change <= 0.005

smallest_additional_experiment_required.name: unlimited_q2_timestep_limiter_attribution
smallest_additional_experiment_required.description: Propagate the same embedded positive Q1 law with Q2 and no positivity correction at dt=0.000625 and 0.0003125. Record negativity, mass, covariance, marginals and conservative density change.
smallest_additional_experiment_required.decision_rule: If unlimited Q2 passes the density timestep gate while adaptive Q2 fails, attribute the material sensitivity to accumulated postprocessing and prototype local conservative flux correction. If unlimited Q2 also fails, investigate time integration before selecting a positivity architecture.
